items.title: Common types of programming errors and bugs (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Common types of programming errors and bugs (PDF 64-65, printed 60-61), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: Syntax error tab hota hai jab code language ke qawaid (rules) nahi manta. Logic error mein program chalta hai magar ghalat nateeja deta hai. Runtime error program chalte waqt aata hai (jaise zero se taqseem). Doosre aam bugs data ki ghaltiyan (data errors) aur resource leaks (jaise file ya connection band na karna) hain. In ghaltiyon ko pehchanna mazboot applications banane ki kunji hai (Figure 5.1).

blocks.caption: Program ki ghaltiyon ki qismein
rows: Code zaban ke qawaid torta hai, is liye program bilkul nahi chalta
if x > 5 (aakhir mein colon : nahi) se SyntaxError: invalid syntax
Program chalte waqt na-durust amal hota hai aur woh ruk jata hai
a = 10; b = 0; result = a / b se ZeroDivisionError
Program chalta hai lekin ghalat nateeja deta hai
length * width ke bajaye area = length + width
Data ki ghaltiyan (ghalat ya bigra data) aur resource leaks (files ya connections kabhi band nahi)
Khuli chhori hui file program khatam hone tak memory gherti rehti hai

blocks.alt: Program errors ki teen qismein. Logic Error: area = length + width se 8 aata hai jo ghalat nateeja hai; durust: area = length * width, output 15. Runtime Error: b = 0 ho to a / b par ZeroDivisionError: division by zero aur program beech mein ruk jata hai. Syntax Error: if x > 5 ke baad colon na ho to SyntaxError: invalid syntax; durust: if x > 5:.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.1: Logic, runtime aur syntax error ki misal (kitab ki Figure 5.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 5.1 ke 'Correct logic' khane mein bhi '# Output: 8 (incorrect result)' chhapa hai. Durust formula area = length * width se 5 x 3 = 15 aata hai, is liye yahan '# Output: 15' likha gaya hai. Logic error mein program chalta hai magar nateeja ghalat hota hai; runtime error program ko beech mein rok deta hai; syntax error mein program shuru hi nahi hota.

blocks.prompt: Do number ka average nikalne wala program 60 aur 80 ke liye 140 print karta hai. Yeh kis qism ki ghalti hai, aur ghaliban durusti kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Logic error: program chalta hai lekin nateeja ghalat hai. Ghaliban yeh jama karta hai aur 2 se taqseem nahi karta; durusti average = (a + b) / 2, jo 70 deta hai.

blocks.text: Figure 5.1 ki do ghaltiyan chala kar dekhein: logic error program ko nahi rokta magar ghalat jawab deta hai, aur runtime error ko try-except se pakar kar program chalta rehta hai. Syntax error wali line yahan nahi likhi, kyunke us ke saath program shuru hi nahi hota. Qeematein badal kar Run karein.

length = 5
width = 3
b = 0          # 0 rakhein to runtime error dekhein

area_wrong = length + width     # logic error: + ki jagah * chahiye
area_right = length * width
print("Logic error wala area:", area_wrong)
print("Durust area:", area_right)

try:
    result = 10 / b
    print("10 / b =", result)
except ZeroDivisionError as e:
    print("Runtime error pakra gaya:", e)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"length = 5", "width = 3", "b = 0": badalne wali qeematein.
"area_wrong = length + width": logic error: program chalta hai magar formula ghalat hai (area ke liye zarb chahiye, jama nahi).
"area_right = length * width": durust formula.
"try: result = 10 / b": b = 0 ho to zero se taqseem runtime error (ZeroDivisionError) deti hai.
"except ZeroDivisionError as e:": ghalti pakar kar us ka paigham e print karta hai, is liye program crash nahi hota.
Output: "Logic error wala area: 8", "Durust area: 15" aur "Runtime error pakra gaya: division by zero".
Khud try karein: b = 4 kar dein: aakhri line "10 / b = 2.5" ho jayegi. length = 6 karne par ghalat area 9 aur durust 18 aayega.

items: Syntax error: program chalta hi nahi; runtime error: beech mein rukta hai; logic error: ghalat nateeja.
Doosre bugs: data errors aur resource leaks.
